theorems.name: Submission.deformation_ipl_mwc_minor_ibp_lipschitz
theorems.statement: ∀ (k Q r : ℕ) (Ω : Set (Eucl k)) (C : ℝ≥0) (a : Fin (r + 1) → Fin Q) (b : Fin (r + 1) → Fin k) (v : Eucl k → Eucl Q) (φ : Eucl k → ℝ), IsOpen Ω → LipschitzOnWith C v Ω → ContDiff ℝ 1 φ → HasCompactSupport φ → tsupport φ ⊆ Ω → ∫ w in Ω, φ w * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin (r + 1) => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t) (fderiv ℝ v w (EuclideanSpace.single (b s) 1))) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k)) = -∑ q : Fin (r + 1), ∫ w in Ω, EuclideanSpace.proj (a 0) (v w) * ((-1 : ℝ) ^ (q : ℕ) * Matrix.det (Matrix.of fun t s : Fin r => EuclideanSpace.proj (a t.succ) (fderiv ℝ v w (EuclideanSpace.single (b (q.succAbove s)) 1)))) * fderiv ℝ φ w (EuclideanSpace.single (b q) 1) ∂(volume : Measure (Eucl k))
